customInstallationSteps.description: Provision App Builder Database Storage and create the collection for checkout field definitions.
customInstallationSteps.name: Set up database

messages.postInstallation: Checkout Fields is installed. Open Checkout Fields in the Commerce Admin to add your first field, then add the storefront kit to your Edge Delivery Services checkout. New fields are off until you switch them on.
messages.preInstallation: Checkout Fields stores field definitions in App Builder Database Storage. Make sure App Builder Data Services is added to your workspace.

metadata.description: Add your own fields to checkout: PO number, delivery notes, VAT ID, gift message or a select. Values are validated on place order and saved on the order as custom attributes.

webhooks.description: Checks the checkout field values on every order before Commerce saves it: required fields, formats, options and dates.
webhooks.label: Validate checkout fields

webhook.fallback_error_message: We couldn't check your checkout details. Please try again.
